name: Rehoboth
overview: Rehoboth appears in Scripture as both a city and a well, reflecting God's provision and blessing. It was a city built by Asshur, as noted in Genesis 10:11, and also associated with the Edomites through the reign of Saul of Rehoboth by the river (Genesis 36:37; 1 Chronicles 1:48). Additionally, Rehoboth is the name Isaac gave to a well he dug after moving from previous wells, signifying that the Lord had made room for them to be fruitful in the land (Genesis 26:22). This dual usage highlights God's faithfulness in providing space and sustenance for His people.
